parameters.name: time_horizon
parameters.description: Number of decision periods in the planning horizon

parameters.name: initial_capital
parameters.description: Initial liquid capital available at time 0

parameters.name: availability_sets
parameters.description: Allowed investment periods for each product

parameters.name: maturity_delays
parameters.description: Maturity delay for each product in periods

parameters.name: gross_multipliers
parameters.description: Gross payout multiplier at maturity for each product

parameters.name: capacities
parameters.description: Investment capacity for each product; may be finite or unlimited

variables.name: investment_amounts
variables.description: Amount invested in product p at the beginning of period t

variables.name: liquid_cash_balances
variables.description: Liquid cash available at the beginning of each decision time t

variables.name: terminal_wealth
variables.description: Total wealth at the end of period T

constraints.name: nonnegative_investment_amounts
constraints.description: investment amounts are nonnegative for all products and periods

constraints.name: nonnegative_cash_balances
constraints.description: liquid cash balances are nonnegative for all decision times

constraints.name: allowed_purchase_periods_only
constraints.description: investment in a product is only allowed in its permitted periods

constraints.name: capacity_limit_per_product_period
constraints.description: investment in any product during a period cannot exceed its capacity when capacity is finite

constraints.name: cash_availability_limit
constraints.description: cash used for investments in a period cannot exceed cash available at the beginning of that period including matured proceeds

constraints.name: no_borrowing_or_negative_cash
constraints.description: borrowing, leverage, and negative cash positions are not allowed

constraints.name: matured_proceeds_arrive_later
constraints.description: proceeds from an investment become liquid cash after the product-specific maturity delay
constraints.formula: \text{proceeds from } x_{p,t} \text{ arrive after } d_p \text{ periods}

constraints.name: cash_carry_forward
constraints.description: cash not invested in a period remains liquid and carries forward to the next period

constraints.name: initial_cash_balance
constraints.description: the initial liquid cash available at the beginning of the horizon equals the given initial capital

constraints.name: terminal_wealth_definition
constraints.description: terminal wealth equals the cash balance at the end of the final period plus any proceeds that mature after period T if such proceeds are included in the horizon valuation; here terminal wealth is identified with the ending liquid cash position after period T

objectives.name: terminal_wealth_maximization
objectives.description: maximize the total wealth at the end of period T

final_objective.description: Maximize terminal wealth at the end of period T.
